split_rule: SHA1(source_file) first 8 hex digits modulo 5 equals 0 for development; otherwise test

metrics.MRR: untruncated reciprocal rank, renamed from the original script's inaccurate MRR@10 field; values unchanged
metrics.nDCG@10: discounted single source-document positive within ranks 1-10
metrics.Recall@5/10/20: single source-document positive found within each cutoff

lexical_inputs: coarse subject, relation, coarse object; fixed schema terms for the schema baseline
ontology_inputs: coarse query plus hierarchy expansion seeded by ORIGINAL fine-grained subject and object, plus fixed schema terms
fusion: (1-alpha) * minmax(coarse BM25 scores) + alpha * minmax(expanded BM25 scores)
positive_definition: source document attached to the validated relation record
limitation: input information differs; this does not isolate an ontology-only effect or independent expert relevance
hybrid_query_ranks: not stored in the original per-query CSV; aggregate archived value preserved
historical_manifest_note: The original coarse_task description is inaccurate about the expansion seeds; this protocol follows the actual script.
